subject: Robotics Equipment Donation
overview: The School Committee approved a record-length consent agenda featuring $180,000 in donated robotics equipment before entering executive session for labor negotiations.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Donations
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included meeting minutes, payroll, and several large donations for the vocational program and science prizes.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to conduct strategy sessions regarding ongoing contract negotiations with district unions and the Director of Food Services.
